en: An |Efficient| ability refunds 1 |CORE POWER| at the end of any scene in which it was used, so it is available again in the next one.

Barely larger than the cannon bolted through it, the Fitzgerald is what happens when a shipyard is asked for artillery and answers with a recoil problem. Its gunners do not need to see what they are shooting at, and its chassis does not expect to survive doing so.
The Fitzgerald receives +1 Difficulty on all SYSTEMS saves and checks.
The BIZARRE CANNON is built through the Fitzgerald's chassis rather than mounted on it: it occupies no weapon mount and cannot take a weapon mod.
On attack: you take 2 AP kinetic damage and are knocked back 2 spaces, away from the direction of fire.
